text:
The Kestrel plan (3–10 Nov) sets corrected values: export ttl_s 270; tenant timeout_s 75 and queue_depth 440; search and inventory max_workers 16; archive max_workers 26; upload ttl_s 360; ledger max_workers 32. Client requirements include webhooks max_workers 20 and timeout_s 40; inventory ttl_s 360; audit ttl_s 510; media batch_size 700; search queue_depth 90; backup queue_depth 400; cache timeout_s 25.

Rollout order: webhooks before alerts, shipping before checkout, indexer before notify.

Separation rules: no dependency paths from archive to media or from alerts to gateway; archive must not depend on upload; shipping must not depend on inventory; checkout and tenant never share a worker.

Ownership: webhooks and search (alpha); tenant, session, and media (beta); alerts and export (gamma); auth (delta).

Other: several conditional couplings link settings across modules. Code review should take under a day. The security review is at month-end, and the on-call rota and budget review move to next month. No linter decision yet.
